comment:
* Represent the GeneralSubtree ASN.1 object, whose syntax is: * 
 * GeneralSubtree ::= SEQUENCE {
 *    base             GeneralName,
 *    minimum  [0]     BaseDistance DEFAULT 0,
 *    maximum  [1]     BaseDistance OPTIONAL
 * }
 * BaseDistance ::= INTEGER (0..MAX)
 *
* @author Amit Kapoor * @author Hemma Prafullchandra

methods.name: public int getMinimum()
methods.comment:
* Return the minimum BaseDistance.
     *
     * @return the minimum BaseDistance. Default is 0 if not set.

methods.name: public int getMaximum()
methods.comment:
* Return the maximum BaseDistance.
     *
     * @return the maximum BaseDistance, or -1 if not set.

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment: * Return a printable string of the GeneralSubtree.

methods.name: public boolean equals(Object other)
methods.comment:
* Compare this GeneralSubtree with another
     *
     * @param other GeneralSubtree to compare to this
     * @returns true if match

methods.name: public int hashCode()
methods.comment:
* Returns the hash code for this GeneralSubtree.
     *
     * @return a hash code value.

methods.name: public void encode(DerOutputStream out) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Encode the GeneralSubtree.
     *
     * @params out the DerOutputStream to encode this object to.
